question: A transparent medium has critical angle $45^\circ$ for its boundary with air. Find its refractive index with respect to air and state whether a ray incident inside the medium at $60^\circ$ will undergo total internal reflection.

options.B: $n=2$; the ray undergoes partial reflection at $60^\circ$.
options.C: For a medium-air boundary, $\sin C=\dfrac{1}{n}$. Thus $\sin45^\circ=\dfrac{1}{n}$, so $n=\sqrt{2}$. Since $60^\circ>45^\circ$, the ray undergoes total internal reflection.
options.D: $n=\sqrt{2}$, but the ray refracts because $60^\circ$ is greater than the critical angle.
